photos.title: Beach Cove Resort from above
photos.what: Beach Cove Resort from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): the resort stands on the beach in North Myrtle Beach, with its pool deck and winding blue lazy river between the building and the dunes; the beach and the Atlantic Ocean run along the lower right. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: Beach Cove Resort from above, with its pool deck and lazy river on the beach side.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of Beach Cove Resort in North Myrtle Beach, labelled, with its pool deck and winding lazy river beside the beach and the Atlantic Ocean
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-14; the exact request is in source_request.
